label: Neblio REST API Suite
description: Read the Neblio blockchain, build unsigned NTP1 token transactions, and broadcast signed transactions

operations.name: get_token_id
operations.description: Returns the tokenId representing a token. GET /ntp1/tokenid/{tokensymbol}.

operations.name: broadcast_tx
operations.description: Broadcasts a signed raw transaction to the network. POST /ntp1/broadcast.

operations.name: get_address_info
operations.description: Information On a Neblio Address. GET /ntp1/addressinfo/{address}.

operations.name: get_transaction_info
operations.description: Information On an NTP1 Transaction. GET /ntp1/transactioninfo/{txid}.

operations.name: get_token_metadata
operations.description: Get Metadata of Token. GET /ntp1/tokenmetadata/{tokenid}.

operations.name: get_token_metadata_of_utxo
operations.description: Get UTXO Metadata of Token. GET /ntp1/tokenmetadata/{tokenid}/{utxo}.

operations.name: get_token_holders
operations.description: Get Addresses Holding a Token. GET /ntp1/stakeholders/{tokenid}.

operations.name: issue_token
operations.description: Builds a transaction that issues a new NTP1 Token. POST /ntp1/issue.

operations.name: send_token
operations.description: Builds a transaction that sends an NTP1 Token. POST /ntp1/sendtoken.

operations.name: burn_token
operations.description: Builds a transaction that burns an NTP1 Token. POST /ntp1/burntoken.

operations.name: send_tx
operations.description: Broadcasts a signed raw transaction to the network (not NTP1 specific). POST /ins/tx/send.

operations.name: get_block
operations.description: Returns information regarding a Neblio block. GET /ins/block/{blockhash}.

operations.name: get_block_index
operations.description: Returns block hash of block. GET /ins/block-index/{blockindex}.

operations.name: get_tx
operations.description: Returns transaction object. GET /ins/tx/{txid}.

operations.name: get_raw_tx
operations.description: Returns raw transaction hex. GET /ins/rawtx/{txid}.

operations.name: get_address
operations.description: Returns address object. GET /ins/addr/{address}.

operations.name: get_address_balance
operations.description: Returns address balance in sats. GET /ins/addr/{address}/balance.

operations.name: get_address_unconfirmed_balance
operations.description: Returns address unconfirmed balance in sats. GET /ins/addr/{address}/unconfirmedBalance.

operations.name: get_address_total_received
operations.description: Returns total received by address in sats. GET /ins/addr/{address}/totalReceived.

operations.name: get_address_utxos
operations.description: Returns all UTXOs at a given address. GET /ins/addr/{address}/utxo.

operations.name: get_address_total_sent
operations.description: Returns total sent by address in sats. GET /ins/addr/{address}/totalSent.

operations.name: get_txs
operations.description: Get transactions by block or address. GET /ins/txs.

operations.name: get_sync
operations.description: Get node sync status. GET /ins/sync.
